result.instructions: Tools for BlueCamroo, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Find the organization named Acme in BlueCamroo and show its owner and addresses."; "Which open cases are assigned to my team in BlueCamroo?"; "Add a task to follow up with the contact at Acme next Tuesday.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes BlueCamroo data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run bluecamroo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run bluecamroo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run bluecamroo_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. bluecamroo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: bluecamroo_search_organizations
tools.title: Search organizations
tools.description: Search organizations (accounts) with one rule: a property name, an operator and a value. Example: Name = Acme. Read only. BlueCamroo: POST api/account/search.

field.description: Organization property to match, for example Name, OwnerId or IsCustomer.

operator.description: Comparison operator, for example = (as in the BlueCamroo search object).

id.description: Object id, from a search or a list call in BlueCamroo.

tools.name: bluecamroo_add_organization
tools.title: Add organization
tools.description: Create an organization (account). Id is set to 0 for you. Give Name and any other properties in fields. BlueCamroo: POST api/account/add.

fields.description: Object properties by BlueCamroo name, for example { "Name": "Acme Ltd", "OwnerId": 1 }. Only the given properties change on update. Id is set for you.

tools.name: bluecamroo_update_organization
tools.title: Update organization
tools.description: Change properties of one organization. The current object is read first, then only the given fields change. BlueCamroo: GET api/account/get/{id}, then PUT api/account/update.

id.description: Object id, from a search or a list call in BlueCamroo.

fields.description: Object properties by BlueCamroo name, for example { "Name": "Acme Ltd", "OwnerId": 1 }. Only the given properties change on update. Id is set for you.

fields.description: Object properties by BlueCamroo name, for example { "Name": "Acme Ltd", "OwnerId": 1 }. Only the given properties change on update. Id is set for you.

tools.name: bluecamroo_add_task

tools.description: Create a task. Give Subject and, for a child task, ParentId and ParentObject (for example account, person, project or case) in fields. Priority is Low, Normal or High. BlueCamroo: POST api/task/add.

fields.description: Object properties by BlueCamroo name, for example { "Name": "Acme Ltd", "OwnerId": 1 }. Only the given properties change on update. Id is set for you.
